lines.text: Hannah stopped to fix her boot.
When she looked up, fog had swallowed the trail, and her group with it.
She shouted. The wind took her voice.
Every hiker in the group carries a whistle on a pack strap.
Agree on simple signals before you start: one blast means stop and wait, three means help.
Hannah blew once, and one whistle answered from just ahead.
Save this before your next group hike.
